title: Tala Durith
subtitle: The Hidden Path
description: Tala Durith was an Imperial double agent, in truth serving The Path, a group concerned with protecting what was left of life before the Empire. Durith came to the rescue of Obi-Wan Kenobi and Leia Organa on Mapuzo, leading them to safety. Quick-thinking Tala evaded capture after being discovered by the Empire but was tragically killed after having sacrificed herself on Jabiim.
